==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will use this spirit as soon as combat has been entered.

== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Recuperation]].
* At a glance, a maximum of +3 health regeneration doesn't sound like a lot, but consider that it affects all allies within [[spirit range]]. ''(In regards to ''[[party healing]]'', this equates to 17.6 health-to-energy ratio, multiplied by # of allies.)'' That includes non-[[party]] members such as allied [[NPC]]s ([[Master Togo]], [[Mhenlo]], etc.), [[minion]]s, [[animal companion]]s and, in the case of two-party cooperative missions, members of the ''other'' party.
* Combined with [[Ritual Lord]], a level 17 Recuperation will heal 8 [[health]] per second, for a maximum 424 health per ally within range throughout its lifespan at rank 19 Restoration Magic and 16 [[Spawning Power]] (with Ritual Lord).
